title: Tool call
description: One tool the agent called: its name in words, a status badge (chờ, đang chạy, xong, lỗi, chờ duyệt), and on open the input and output (JSON formatted).
when: Agent runs and chats where the model calls functions, MCP tools or APIs.

instead.need: A shell command and its output

a11y: The row is a disclosure button; status is text in the badge, not colour only; an error is role="alert".
notes: Give title in words (“Tìm máy in rảnh”); name (the tool id) shows inside.
Put an ActionConfirmation inside (children) when the call waits for approval.
